The spec requires returning `("", nil)` so RunE treats the empty string as a graceful no-op and exits with code 0. replan_context: review:code_quality:error:cmd/gromit-next/exec.go:485 — The --specs-dir flag is not registered on the exec spec command. pickSpec cannot be driven from cobra in tests and the --specs-dir shortcut path (skipping ResolveProjectConfigPath/LoadProjectConfig) is never reachable. (suggested fix: Add `cmd.Flags().String("specs-dir", "", "Override specs directory (for testing)")` before the return statement.)

review:spec_alignment:error:cmd/gromit-next/exec.go:489 — `NoOptDefVal` is not set on the `--resume` flag. Passing `--resume` with no value is a cobra parse error rather than setting the flag to the sentinel `"__pick__"`, making the resume picker permanently unreachable via the intended bare `--resume` invocation. (suggested fix: After `cmd.Flags().String("resume", "", "...")`, add `cmd.Flags().Lookup("resume").NoOptDefVal = "__pick__"`.)
